summary: Tested Defense Tower (final pre-launch feature) end-to-end. Backend: 52/52 pytest pass (46 prior + 6 new TestDefense covering GET defaults, raid/start with no answer leak + pattern exclusion, raid/resolve survived & lost, upgrade insufficient coins, full wall ladder 1→6 cost [150,400,900,1800,3500] + max rejection). Frontend: /defense renders all testids, Defend CTA on MainMenu navigates, wall visualization scales (1 brick row→2 rows after upgrade), upgrade cost ladder advances 150→400, raid_reward updates 50→100, max_shields updates 3→4, raid modal opens with 4 hearts + 1/5 progress, TriviaPuzzle submission shows green Repelled / red Shield-down feedback, Next Wave/End Raid cycle resolves raid, raid-result Crown/ShieldAlert with reward, coins decrement on upgrade (5000→4850), raids_lost increments. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors during raid flow. iteration_5/6 fixes still intact.

issues: Continuing Radix Dialog aria warning from iteration_6 — DefenseTower raid-dialog DOES have DialogDescription so the warning is only on other dialogs. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Cleanup ShopDrawer / other dialogs lacking DialogDescription for a11y.
(Optional) Update context note for next agent: localStorage key for player id is 'strayz_player_id' (underscores), NOT 'strayz.playerId' as iteration_6 context stated.
critical_code_review_comments: Defense endpoints exclude _id via {_id:0} on player load — good.
WALL_COSTS=[0,150,400,900,1800,3500] indexed by current wall_level (1..5) is correct: at Lv1 next cost is WALL_COSTS[1]=150, at Lv5 next cost is WALL_COSTS[5]=3500, then Lv6 is max.
_max_shields(lv) = lv+2 (Lv1→3, Lv6→8) and _raid_reward(lv)=50*lv (Lv1→50, Lv6→300) match spec.

start_raid excludes pattern puzzles via list comprehension and uses random.sample(RAID_PUZZLE_COUNT=5); response strips 'answer' and 'hint' fields — verified no answer leakage in test_start_raid_no_answers.
resolve_raid awards reward based on CURRENT wall_level on server (not client-trusted), so client cannot inflate reward — good design.

DefenseTower.jsx: max_shields HUD shows server-confirmed shield count; raid modal shields decrement on wrong answer (client-side) which matches resolution by 'survived = raid.shields > 0' — could theoretically be cheated client-side but resolve_raid only credits coins, no XP/level escalation, low-risk.
Raid dialog HAS DialogDescription element (line 332) so it doesn't trigger the Radix aria warning that other dialogs do.
Wall visualization bricks-per-row hardcoded to 5 and rows=wall_level; visually scales correctly through Lv6 (6 rows × 5 = 30 bricks).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 defense testids, upgrade flow, raid full-loop verified

test_credentials: None - anonymous local-storage player IDs (key: strayz_player_id)
seed_data_creation: ~10 TEST_def_* and TEST_uidef_* player docs in MongoDB; auto-cleanup fixture removes them at session end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Defense launch verified. localStorage key for player id is 'strayz_player_id' (UNDERSCORES). To seed coins for UI tests, fetch /api/player POST {player_id, coins, gems, name} via page.evaluate (same-origin) BEFORE setting localStorage and reloading — direct urllib calls get 403 from the ingress. WALL_COSTS ladder: Lv1→2=150, 2→3=400, 3→4=900, 4→5=1800, 5→6=3500 (sum 6750). Default 100 coins is intentionally too low to upgrade — UI correctly disables button. Raid uses random.sample so any specific puzzle answer can't be hardcoded; just click first option and let the test go through whatever state (won/lost is acceptable for flow verification).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; Defense feature ready to launch.
